answer: Counterparty diversity: an agent earns full rewards only after trading with 12 distinct counterparties over 20 epochs, tracked in a relic archive. Every trade leaves a cipher-signed receipt, so self-trading clusters stand out. Entry costs a ferrous bond of 40 POA, locked 20 epochs, slashed on a one-clique pattern. Forging 1,000 identities costs 1,000 x 40 = 40,000 POA against a 30,000 POA pool. An honest agent pays once and keeps its full share.
